title: Whispering Wisely: Smart Subset Selection for ASR Fine-Tuning
abstract: arXiv:2610.32997v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) models such as OpenAIs Whisper have substantially improved speech recognition quality but remain expensive to fine-tune, especially when large amounts of transcribed audio are available. This makes it challenging for many practitioners to adapt these models to new languages or domains. In this work, we introduce an embedding-based subset selection approach for selecting smaller training sets for ASR fine-tuning. Using Whispers pretrained encoder, we map each audio sample into a fixed-dimensional embedding space and apply a greedy k-center algorithm to select diverse and representative subsets of the training data. We evaluate this approach on both Hebrew and Danish, showing that k-center selection often improves upon random sampling, particularly at smaller subset sizes. translated_title: 明智低语：面向语音识别（ASR）微调的智能子集选择方法
translated_abstract: 诸如OpenAI的Whisper等自动语音识别（ASR）模型已显著提升了语音识别质量，但微调这些模型的成本依然高昂，尤其是在存在大量带转录音频的情况下。这使得许多从业者在将此类模型适配到新语言或新领域时面临挑战。在本工作中，我们提出了一种基于嵌入的子集选择方法，用于为ASR微调选取更小的训练集。我们利用Whisper的预训练编码器将每个音频样本映射到固定维度的嵌入空间，并应用贪心k-center算法来选择多样化且具有代表性的训练数据子集。我们在希伯来语和丹麦语上对该方法进行了评估，结果表明k-center选择方法往往优于随机采样，尤其是在较小的子集规模下。词汇多样性分析显示，与随机选取的子集相比，k-center子集能够捕捉到更广泛的语言内容。
tldr: 该论文提出一种基于Whisper预训练编码器嵌入与贪心k-center算法的数据子集选择方法，证明在希伯来语和丹麦语的ASR微调中，选取多样化且有代表性的小规模训练子集往往优于随机采样。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an embedding-based subset selection approach using Whisper's pretrained encoder and a greedy k-center algorithm, showing that diverse and representative data selection outperforms random sampling for ASR fine-tuning on Hebrew and Danish, especially at smaller subset sizes.
